overview_description.description:
Firebolt is the cloud data warehouse for builders of next-gen analytics experiences. Combining the benefits and ease-of-use of a modern architecture with sub-second performance at terabyte scale, Firebolt helps data engineering and dev teams deliver data applications that end-users love.

The company was founded in 2019 and is based in Tel Aviv, Israel.

about_short_description.short_description: Firebolt is a cloud data warehousing platform that allows users to streamline their analytics and access to insights.

product.name: Firebolt Cloud Data Warehouse
product.description: A cloud-native data warehousing platform designed for sub-second SQL query performance, high concurrency, and elastic scaling to support AI and analytics workloads.

product.name: Firebolt Core
product.description: A free, self-hosted version of Firebolt’s query engine that runs production-grade SQL queries locally or in any environment via Docker.

product.name: Fast Data Ingestion
product.description: A data ingestion service that enables rapid, scalable, and cost-effective loading and transformation of data into Firebolt using SQL and integrations with popular tools.

product.name: Cloud Data Warehouse Security
product.description: A multi-layered security framework for Firebolt’s cloud data warehouse that includes encryption, access control, identity management, and compliance features.

product.name: Firebolt Workspace
product.description: A collaborative environment for data engineers, analytics engineers, developers, and DevOps to manage data lifecycle, security, governance, and SQL development.

product.name: Firebolt Integrations
product.description: A set of integrations connecting Firebolt with popular data visualization, transformation, orchestration, and application development tools.
